[b]The Circle, main military base[/b]

[i]"Sir, the war is progressing slowly." Yells the head of the Department of War. "We need to launch a full invasion of the raj. Men are dying, and each of their deaths are less of an advancement. Epikanus has deployed troops slowing us down, and we have not done anything about it." He shuffles through some of his papers to find a red and yellow striped folder, "There is a communist revolution starting on the mainland. Epikanus has just attacked it, so they are struggling.  We have already liberated the seas near there, so what my command has been scheming, is a landing, thwn a flow of supplies into the party. Surely they expect us to help them."[/i] One of the army high commanders takes the folder from the head, and reads on it, reciting the reported manpower, and equipent. The room went quiet, reading on the war reports (deployments, recruitments, casualties, ect.) After an hour, they decided to launch a full invasion of the raj along with a steady supply of soldiers and equipment into the communist party. Their response was a warm welcome, along with many thanks.

[b] Squadron 7 | Southern Mainland Raj[/b]

[b][Click*][/b] "You're ready for engines" Says the air command. [b][Whirrrr*][/b] [b][CSHHH*][/b] [i]*Engine one and two active*[/i] [b][CSHHH*][/b] "You're ready for takeoff" [b][FUSHOOFFF*][/b] The fighter was in the sky, taking off from the large carrier.  For 3 minutes, there was nervousness, then more planes and bullets came into sight. Dodging left and right, up and down, the pilot, George, finally found an opening, and a chance for a win in a dogfight. [b][Whatever sound a chain of bullets shooting makes*][/b] After 10 minutes of fighting, he had severely hit the enemy plane. Another 5 minutes and he had blown off the right wing of the plane, but somehow it kept flying. "Damn, how! I completely blew off the wing, yet it flies! Maybe just one more missile, and it will finally retire." George murmurs to his self. Finally, he used his last missile from his left wing, and destroyed the enemy. [b][Alarm blair*][/b] [i]*Missile detected, activating flares*[/i] Flares launch from the sides of the plane, illuminating the sky- [b][Boom*][/b] [b][Whatever sound a chain of bullets shooting makes*][/b] "Damn it! Another guy is on me, and I'm almost out of ammo! I have to blow him with a small amount of weopons. My flares are out, so if he shoots a missile at me I'm gonna be toast!" George had to maneuver his way out of death, but luckily, a teammate shot him down just as he got free. They were both almost out of ammunition, so they had to get back to the carrier to refill. On their way, they saw 3 transport ships, and 2 cargo ships on their way from where they came from. "What operation is this? After I refill, I will investigate, as well as provide support, you in, buddy?" "No. The air command said to achieve air superiority, we must not disobey, you know this, George." Answered his team mate, Caesar. "We can't afford the consequences, both from the enemy, and the Airforce. Leave it at that!" "You didnt answer my first question"- "Its a full scale invasion. Now leave it. Do not go by yourself." Caesar interrupted. "Fine, I guess I'll not go by myself." George murmured, "without a refill, heh."

[b]Transport boat three | Southern Mainland Raj[/b]

The transport boats landed on a small area of the lower section of the mainland raj, expecting a large battle, which there was. Thousands and thousands of people died trying to land, but the arenetts just barely managed to land by the burned hairs on their arm. [b][Boom*][/b] 2 missiles stuck them with no mercy! "I guess we got a taste of our own medicine." Yells a soldier to his comrades. "There was probably only 3 deaths! The general was smart to have us put decoy guns in that building! Well, I left them a little surprise. I hid a sentry gun inside one of the buildings to kill any enemy who did make it inside, Just incase they tried to see if they were fake or not." "You did what? Why would you do that!" Screams his officer, "that was one of our only 5 sentries that we have, and it's experimental, meaning we can't get more!" "Relax, bushy brows." Laughs José, "It was only one." "These locals were fighting for their life! It's incredible how they manages to survive this whole time!" Comments another soldier. "It is, if you didn't know even now, I am one of those soldiers. If I survive today, tomorrow I'm going back to Arenenge temporarily to get trained, and possibly TO train." Says one of the GCPR soldiers, "Drone attacks were brutal, I'm 90% sure I'm going to have PTSD with drones" he chuckles lightly, "We thank you for saving us. We might have been completely suppressed if you waited for another day." 

836 words.
